description: This file is a complete frontend HTML page for a database visualizer. It provides a user interface with a sidebar listing databases, expandable tables, and a data display area that loads and displays database table data, supporting features like refresh, dynamic table rendering, and content expansion.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the backend API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for the selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in the main view.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data into HTML and displays it.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handles expansion for large or object data.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding or collapsing cell content for detailed view.
